edges.reason: The constructor stores msg.sender into creator, which later gates privileged transfer behaviour
The constructor assigns the full _totalSupply to msg.sender in _balances
creator is compared against sender inside _transfer to enable the desepticons whitelist branch
desepticons controls whether megatron[recipient] is force-enabled during _transfer
elephant is read by _transfer to require(amount < elephant) for non-whitelisted senders
saslaisgood is consumed and incremented as the entropy seed of randomly()
block.timestamp (now) is used directly as randomness entropy in randomly(), a timestamp dependency
The result of randomly() determines quatkum[recipient], controlling privileged state from a weak random value
randomly() produces the miner-influenceable value that is the unsafe randomness operation
BurnOptimusPrime lets the owner overwrite elephant, the transfer-size threshold
SetBurnAddress reads the stored picture address as the ownership source
picture is copied into _owner during SetBurnAddress, silently transferring ownership
The picture address feed the unguarded ownership-change operation
Any caller (msg.sender) can invoke SetBurnAddress because no owner check guards the ownership change
The unguarded ownership change writes the attacker-reachable picture value into _owner
CheckTheAddress writes val into megatron[spender], granting or removing privileged status
CheckTheAddress writes val2 into quatkum[spender], altering allowance/transfer override behaviour
FruitBowl invokes _mint for msg.sender, creating new tokens at owner discretion
_mint increases _totalSupply through SafeMath add
_mint increases _balances[account] through SafeMath add
_transfer subtracts from and adds to _balances using SafeMath
_burn decreases _totalSupply through SafeMath sub
_burn decreases _balances[account] through SafeMath sub
transfer forwards the call to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom forwards the call to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom updates the allowance by calling _approve after the transfer
approve forwards the call to the internal _approve routine
quatkum[owner] decides whether the requested allowance is replaced with the constant 1234 in _approve
keyboard gates a one-shot megatron/quatkum whitelist write inside _approve
creator is compared against owner inside _approve to trigger the keyboard whitelist branch
_approve performs the silent allowance override operation (tok = 1234 when quatkum[owner])
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership routine
SetBurnAddress executes the unguarded ownership-change operation
_owner is compared against picture in the require of SetBurnAddress, gating when the seizure can happen
amount parameter flows into the _transfer balance arithmetic and the elephant comparison
sender parameter flows into the _transfer gate checks and balance debit
recipient parameter flows into the _transfer whitelist gates and balance credit
newOwner parameter is validated and stored into _owner by _transferOwnership
spender parameter is written into _allowances by _approve
account parameter is debited and _totalSupply reduced in _burn
val parameter is written into megatron[spender] by CheckTheAddress
val2 parameter is written into quatkum[spender] by CheckTheAddress
addedValue is added to the current allowance via SafeMath before _approve
subtractedValue is subtracted from the current allowance via SafeMath before _approve
owner parameter is used for the creator/quatkum gate and allowance storage in _approve
tempval copies _totalSupply and is returned by ViewTheTaxi
screen holds the pseudo-random value produced by randomly()
tok carries the overridden allowance value into the silent allowance-override operation
msgSender (local copy of msg.sender) is stored into _owner and picture during construction

normalization_plan.reason: recipient only exists as the destination address parameter of the transfer routines implemented by _transfer
amount only parametrises the balance arithmetic and elephant threshold check performed in _transfer
sender only parametrises the source-address gates and balance debit performed in _transfer
spender only parametrises the allowance write performed in _approve
newOwner only parametrises the ownership update performed in _transferOwnership
account only parametrises the balance and supply mutation performed in _burn
val only parametrises the megatron flag write performed by CheckTheAddress
val2 only parametrises the quatkum flag write performed by CheckTheAddress
addedValue is only an arithmetic operand feeding the _approve allowance update
subtractedValue is only an arithmetic operand feeding the _approve allowance update
ownerParam only parametrises the creator/quatkum gate and allowance key used in _approve
screen is the transient return value produced by the weak-randomness routine randomly
tok is the transient value that implements the silent 1234 allowance override
msgSender is the transient msg.sender copy stored into _owner and picture during construction
